subject: Re: Request — temporary SIEM export & extended tenant retention window
messages:
From: Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@clarityrx.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clarityrx.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SIEM export & extended retention for tenant RX-237

Hi Grace,

Quick note from ClarityRx Security — we're opening a short regulatory inquiry for one of our production tenants (RX-237). Regulator is asking for access to a 90-day log history and an immediate push of recent telemetry to our SIEM to support incident reconstruction.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood temporarily extend the retention window for RX-237 from the default 30 days to 90 days for session + inference traces (we only need metadata and request/response hashes; we do NOT need full model inputs that contain PHI).
- Can you provide an automated export to our SIEM (syslog over TLS or S3 with delivery hooks) covering the last 90 days, plus an initial ad-hoc export of the last 7 days within 24 hours?

Please list: any required contract amendments or DPA changes, lead time, evidence (SOC 2 or SIG/CAIQ artifacts) we can send to the regulator to show controls around data segregation and deletion, and whether Redwood can deliver an export that excludes raw PII content (we'd prefer tokenized/redacted payloads). I've attached a short outline of our ask.

Appreciate a quick feasibility check. If helpful we can set up a 30-min call later today.

Thanks,
Ankit
Security Ops, ClarityRx
(attachment: clarityrx-request-outline.pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@clarityrx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SIEM export & extended retention for tenant RX-237

Hi Ankit — thanks for the clear scope. Looping in Marissa (Customer Success) and Karthik (Security/Platform) to confirm feasibility and timeline. Quick summary of what we can do and immediate asks from our side: 

What we can offer (high level):
- Temporary retention extension: We can provision a tenant-scoped retention policy override for RX-237 to 90 days for session and inference metadata. This will be applied at the tenant slice level and marked as a temporary policy change (admin flag + audit entry).
- SIEM export options: two paths — (1) push over syslog/TLS to your SIEM collector, or (2) S3 export (parquet/ndjson) with lifecycle and access logs, plus an event-driven SNS webhook for near-real-time delivery.

Immediate evidence we can share: SOC 2 excerpts relevant to data segregation and deletion, and our SIG/CAIQ control mappings for data lifecycle. I've attached the SOC 2 excerpt for quick review. Full SIG packet requires an NDA/portal access; we can schedule an evidence handoff if required.

Questions from our side to scope work and risk:
- Confirmation that ClarityRx only needs metadata + hashed/request ids, not full user-submitted PII. If any payloads must be redacted, please provide sample payloads or a list of fields to strip.
- Desired export protocol (syslog vs S3) and contact details for the SIEM collector.
- Requested retention start date (do you want a retroactive 90-day preserve or forward-looking from the change date?). Retroactive preservation requires a snapshot/export job and legal approval.

Next steps proposed:
1) Karthik to validate platform change window and provide an estimated lead time (aiming for the 24-hour ad-hoc export for the last 7 days).
2) Marissa will capture a mutual action plan and contract amendment requirements.
3) If you confirm we will provision a backfilled export and retention override pending legal approval and a signed amendment.

I can hop on a quick call if you prefer—available 2pm PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-soc2-excerpt.pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ankit Shah <ankit.shah@clarityrx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SIEM export & extended retention for tenant RX-237

Thanks Grace — technical notes below. I am available to be on the call if needed.

Feasibility and knobs:
- Retention override: We support tenant-specific TTL overrides. For RX-237 we can set session+inference-metadata TTL to 90 days via an admin API. Change will take effect immediately for new writes.
- Retroactive preservation: For retroactive coverage we will run a backfill job that extracts the last 90 days from our cold-store snapshots and places them in a tenant-scoped export bucket. Estimated runtime: 2–6 hours depending on volume.
- Export formats: We can emit ndjson (recommended) or parquet. For syslog push we will stream events over TLS with mutual auth. For S3 delivery we will create a time-partitioned bucket and supply presigned URLs or cross-account role access.
- PII redaction/tokenization: We can redact fields at export time using configurable field masks; alternatively we can deliver hashed identifiers. We will need a small sample (10–20 records) to validate the mask without disclosing data.
- Audit & deletion manifest: Every policy override and export will generate an immutable audit record (kept per SOC 2 requirements). We will also produce a deletion manifest once the temporary 90-day window expires.

Risks and legal items:
- Retroactive preservation is considered a data-hold and triggers our legal/DSAR workflow; we will need a signed amendment or PO referencing the temporary preservation window and an authorized contact for release.
- Exports that include unredacted model inputs with PHI must be approved by our privacy team — please flag any such data immediately.

Actions I will take: 
- I will create a short-runbook and an export job template and attach it here (retention-policy-snippet.txt).
- Provide an estimated SLA/throughput impact once we have volume numbers (roughly: small volumes <1M events — negligible impact; large volumes may require a short maintenance window).

If ClarityRx confirms protocol and redaction profile we will:
1) Schedule the backfill export job (2–6h window)
2) Apply the 90-day override (tagged as temporary)
3) Deliver the initial 7-day ad-hoc export within 24 hours

- Karthik
Platform Security, Redwood Inference
(attachment: retention-policy-snippet.txt)

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SIEM export & extended retention for tenant RX-237

Grace/Karthik/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming:
- ClarityRx wants the retroactive 90-day preserve covering metadata + hashed request ids for RX-237; we do NOT want any raw free-text model inputs that could include PHI.
- Protocol: S3 export with cross-account role is preferred for bulk backfill; syslog for streaming events is optional.
- We'll sign the amendment you require. Please send the minimal amendment language (one paragraph) and the PO path so procurement can start.

Couple of follow-ups:
- Does the exported data include any internal metadata keys that could be considered customer-identifying beyond tenant id? If yes, please list those fields and we will confirm redaction requirements.
- Is there any retention/immutability window applied to the export bucket independent from the 90-day tenant override? We want to make sure the regulator can access the exported artefacts for the duration requested.

If you can send the amendment language and the export role details today we can get procurement moving. Happy to jump on the 2pm PT call if you still have that slot.

Thanks — Ankit
Security Ops, ClarityRx
